3.title: How can I resolve issues related to microphone in JioMeet?
3.content: How can I resolve issues related to microphone in JioMeet? | If you are experiencing issues using your microphone, follow these steps to troubleshoot the issue: Ensure the microphone is not on mute (If you see the muted Audio icon in the below-left panel, tap it to unmute yourself.) If you are still muted, the host may have muted you upon entering the meeting (Ask to be unmuted by sending a chat message to the host.) Try using earphones with a microphone Ensure JioMeet has access to your device's microphone For iOS: Go to ios Settings > Privacy > Microphone and switch on the toggle for JioMeet. For Android: Go to Settings > Apps & notifications > App permissions > Microphone and switch on the toggle for JioMeet. Please, ensure that no other applications are using the microphone at the same time. For iOS: View recent apps currently running. Swipe up to close an app. For Android: Tap the multi-task button (the square icon usually in the bottom-right corner) to view apps currently running. Now, swipe left or right to close an app. Finally, restart your device. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

37.title: Can I activate Call Forwarding on my JioFiberVoice number?
37.content: Can I activate Call Forwarding on my JioFiberVoice number? | Yes, you can activate Call Forwarding on your JioFiberVoice number so you don’t miss calls on your landline device or any connected smartphones/ Jio Set Top Boxes . You can enable different types of call forwarding based on your needs. Below are all the options and the short codes to activate or deactivate them: Unconditional Call Forwarding Forward every incoming call on your JioFiberVoice number to another number. Activate: Dial *401* Deactivate: Dial *402 Call Forwarding on No Reply (CFNR) Forward calls when you don’t pick up an incoming call on any connected extension. Activate: Dial *403* Deactivate: Dial *404 Call Forwarding on Number Busy (CFB) Forward calls when your JioFiberVoice number is busy on another call. Activate: Dial *405* Deactivate: Dial *406 Call Forwarding on Not Reachable (CFNRc) Forward calls when your JioFiberVoice number is out of coverage or not reachable. Activate: Dial *409* Deactivate: Dial *410 Deactivate all forwarding settings at once In case multiple call forwarding settings are done, all can be deactivated at the same time by dialling *413. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

38.title: What should I do if my TV screen connected to the Jio Set Top Box is showing a blurred image or the colours look mismatched?
38.content: What should I do if my TV screen connected to the Jio Set Top Box is showing a blurred image or the colours look mismatched? | If your TV shows a blurred picture, washed-out colours, or unusual colour tones while using the Jio Set Top Box , it usually happens because of a loose HDMI connection or incorrect display settings. You can fix the picture clarity issues easily by following the steps below. Check and clean the HDMI connection Unplug the HDMI cable from your TV’s HDMI port. Take a small brush or a clean cloth and gently clean the TV’s HDMI port to remove dust. Reconnect the HDMI cable firmly into the same HDMI port. If the issue continues, try plugging the HDMI cable into a different HDMI port on your TV. Check whether the picture quality has improved. If the picture still looks blurred or the colours remain off, try the second method below. Adjust the HDR settings On the Jio Set Top Box, go to 'Settings'. Select 'System Settings'. Choose 'Display Settings'. Choose 'HDR Settings' You will see three options: Auto, On, Off. Select Off to disable HDR. Reboot the Set Top Box and check if the picture quality is now clear. Disabling HDR often fixes colour mismatch issues caused by TV-model compatibility. Still facing the issue? If the problem continues after trying both methods, contact JioFiber Care to raise a service request. Call the toll-free number: 1800-896-9999 A technician will help diagnose and fix the issue at your home. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

199.title: What is the Wi-Fi coverage provided by the Jio Home Gateway on the JioFiber network?
199.content: What is the Wi-Fi coverage provided by the Jio Home Gateway on the JioFiber network? | The JioHome Gateway is designed to give strong, stable Wi-Fi coverage for most Indian homes. In typical conditions, it can comfortably cover an open area of around 1,000 sq. ft. on the same floor. This is ideal for apartments, 1–2 BHK homes, and compact office spaces. However, actual Wi-Fi range can vary because wireless signals are affected by many real-world factors inside your home. What can affect your JioFiber Wi-Fi coverage? Several conditions may reduce or change the coverage area Interference from nearby Wi-Fi routers in your building or neighbourhood Router placement, especially if it’s inside a cabinet, corner, or behind objects Number of walls between the Home Gateway and the device Wall thickness and material (concrete walls weaken signal the most) Distance from the router — signal drops as you move farther away Too many devices connected at once These factors apply to all Wi-Fi networks, not just JioFiber. How to improve JioFiber Wi-Fi coverage? To get better indoor coverage, try the following: Place the Home Gateway in a central, open area Keep it away from metal objects and inside-wall cabinets Make sure no other routers are too close Ensure your issue is not device-specific by checking signal bars Use the MyJio → Run Diagnostics tool to check coverage in real time If you have a larger home or want seamless Wi-Fi in every room, you can also explore: Jio Extenders Mesh Wi-Fi setup JioAirFiber, which offers wider, whole-home coverage Chat with us! 215.title: I am not able to send SMS from my Jio number. What do I do?
215.content: I am not able to send SMS from my Jio number. What do I do? | You can try below mentioned troubleshooting steps: If you are a prepaid user, check if you have an active Recharge plan and have SMS balance left in it. If you are a postpaid user, check that your current usage is within assigned credit limit. If you did a SIM change, your Incoming and Outgoing SMS service will remain barred for 24 hours as per Regulatory guidelines. If you are a postpaid user with 10ARP plan, then you need to have an active Pre on Post Recharge plan to avail the Voice/Data or SMS services. Have you exhausted your daily or monthly quota of SMS? If yes, please recharge with a Top-up voucher to send further SMS. Ensure that the SMS Message Centre Number or Service Centre Number in your handset is updated. The message centre ensures that your text message is sent to the recipient. If the message centre number in your phone is blank, the text message can't be sent. This is normally updated under SMS Settings in your handset. For Android devices in general: To launch the SMS application on your phone: Tap on Menu and go to Settings Scroll down and select 'Message Centre' (If you cannot find Message centre in this list then look for and tap Text message and it should hopefully be in this list) As soon as you open that, you'll be able to see and edit the message centre number. If blank, enter in the number 1234 and click on OK . Restart your phone and send ‘test’ text to check if its working If your Android phone doesn't have the 'Message Centre' option available, then you can find the same by: Typing *#*#4636#*#* into your phone on the dial screen Select Phone information Scroll down and select the SMSC setting Press Refresh to see the current setting If the number is blank then type 1234 and press Update Restart your phone and send send ‘test’ text to check if its working text to make sure it’s working If you are still facing the issue, then try inserting your SIM card in a different handset that is known to send and receive SMS properly. If you can send and receive SMS in another handset, this means there may be an issue with the handset you normally use. If you are unable to send an SMS to a specific number, but are able to send to other numbers, then it indicates that your phone settings and Jio services are working fine and there might be an issue with that specific number/operator. You can ask the recipient to check with their network operator. Please use Jio Chat application to send any multimedia message(s). Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

359.title: How do I transfer my JioFiber connection to a new location if I am relocating?
359.content: How do I transfer my JioFiber connection to a new location if I am relocating? | Moving to your new home? You can easily transfer your JioFiber connection by submitting a relocation request online by visiting the JioFiber page on our website or through the MyJio app. Below are the steps to check JioFiber availability at your new address and raise a relocation request using your preferred channel. Through the Jio website (www.jio.com) Visit www.jio.com/fiber and click ‘Sign In’. Select JioFiber and log in using OTP verification. Click on ‘Settings’ (top-right corner), then select ‘Service Settings’ → ‘Relocate JioFiber’. Enter your new address and tap ‘Proceed’. You can either enter your address manually or use ‘Use My Current Location’. If JioFiber services are available at the new location, upload your Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA). Choose your preferred installation date and time, then submit your relocation request. Through the MyJio App Log in to the MyJio app using your JioFiber number. Tap on "Home" and tap on the 'Profile' option at the top right corner. Tap on ‘Service Settings’, choose ‘Relocate Connection JioFiber’. Enter your new address and tap ‘Proceed’. You can either enter your address manually or use ‘Use My Current Location’ for automatic detection. If JioFiber is available at your new location, you’ll be prompted to upload the required documents. Upload your Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA). Select your preferred date and time for installation, then submit your Relocation Request. Note: Once your documents are successfully validated, a Jio engineer will visit your new address at your preferred time. Please carry your existing JioFiber devices and accessories and hand them over to the engineer during installation to complete the setup. You can click here to track your relocation request anytime. Important points to remember while uploading documents: Upload clear images of both front and back sides of the document. Accepted file format: PDF only (file size must be less than 2 MB). Ensure the file is not password-protected. The name on the document must match the JioFiber account holder’s name. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

502.title: How do I perform an internet speed test for my JioHome?
502.content: How do I perform an internet speed test for my JioHome? | The easiest way to check your internet speed on JioHome is through the JioHome app. It provides the most accurate reading for your home setup, whether you need a quick internet speed test, a more comprehensive network speed test, or a simple network speed test to check how things are performing. You can also use it when you specifically want to check the internet speed, run a wi-fi speed test, or just check wi-fi speed before troubleshooting. Here’s how you can run a speed test on your JioHome: • Open the JioHome app on your phone. • Tap on 'Speed Test' to start an instant data speed test. • You can also go to Network → Wi-Fi Speed to view your last recorded speed and tap 'Test Speed' for a fresh check. If you're using a Wi-Fi Router (JioFiber or JioAirFiber): Select 'Router', then hit 'Test Speed' to run a reliable broadband speed test. This shows how much speed actually reaches your router — super useful for troubleshooting and performing an accurate wi-fi speed test anytime. If you're checking speed on your mobile phone: Select 'Mobile Phone', make sure you're connected to your Jio Wi-Fi, and tap 'Test Speed'. Great for a “What’s my speed right now?” moment or a quick my net speed test, especially if you want to check the internet speed instantly. Want to compare results? You can use any online tool to run a speed test online, a net speed test online, or an internet speed test. These are helpful for a quick reference, but the JioHome app gives you the most accurate numbers because it measures speed directly from your Jio setup — making it more reliable than most generic check wi-fi speed websites. Pro Tip: If you're on a True 5G phone connected to Jio Wi-Fi, your Wi-Fi experience can also reflect 5G backhaul performance. So running a 5G speed test on mobile data vs. Wi-Fi can help you understand the difference — especially when comparing results after doing a wi-fi speed test. Chat with us! 555.title: How do I activate Netflix that comes bundled with my JioFiber plan?
555.content: How do I activate Netflix that comes bundled with my JioFiber plan? | If your JioFiber plan includes a Netflix subscription, you can activate it in just a few steps. You can use MyJio, Jio.com, or your Jio Set Top Box (STB) to start using Netflix on your JioFiber connection. Steps to activate Netflix through MyJio or Jio.com (Recommended) Open the MyJio app or visit Jio.com and log in to your JioFiber account. On the top of the home page, look for the Netflix 'Activate Now' banner. Tap or click 'Activate Now'. You will be redirected to Netflix.com. Follow the on-screen instructions to link your existing Netflix account or create a new Netflix account if you don’t have one. Once linked, your Netflix subscription will be activated under your JioFiber plan, and billing will be managed by Jio. Steps to activate Netflix through the Jio Set Top Box Launch the Netflix app on your TV screen from your Jio Set Top Box. Follow the on-screen instructions to link your existing Netflix account or create a new Netflix account if you don’t have one. Once completed, your Netflix service will be activated through your JioFiber plan benefits. Note: If you already have a Netflix account logged in on the STB, you may need to sign out first before starting the activation process. Good to know: Your Netflix plan depends on the JioFiber plan you have subscribed to. After activation, your Netflix billing is handled by JioFiber, so you won’t be charged separately by Netflix. If you upgrade your JioFiber plan, your Netflix plan benefits may also be upgraded automatically (depending on eligibility). You can enjoy Netflix across devices like TV, mobile, tablet, or laptop, as long as your JioFiber plan includes Netflix access. For any login or linking issues, you can use the Run Diagnostics feature on MyJio or raise a support request. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

740.title: What are the Battery s Do's & Don'ts?
740.content: What are the Battery s Do's & Don'ts? | Here’re the dos and don’ts for the JioFi with Li-ion battery: Do not place the battery in high-temperature environments, such as near a fire or heater (It is dangerous and may cause overheating of the battery, fire, explosion, or battery function failure.) If the temperature in the surrounding environment is too high or too low, the device’s performance could slow down (For stable, fast charging, we recommend charging the device at room temperature.) Do not heat the battery with a soldering iron, hair dryer, or other heating tools. Do not immerse the battery in water; keep it in a secure, cool and dry environment. Do not reverse the battery’s positive and negative terminals during usage. Do not short-circuit the battery (This may seriously damage the battery and may result in fire and explosion.) Do not connect the battery to an electrical outlet (230V AC), as it will damage the battery and may result in fire and explosion. Do not transport or store the battery with metal objects such as hairpins, keys, ornaments, etc. Do not damage the battery by hitting on it with some object, throwing it on the surface, stamping on it, or dropping the battery on the surface from a certain height. Do not try to disassemble the battery (This will cause serious damage to the battery and it becomes unusable.) Do not dispose of the batteries with your regular household waste. (This can lead to poisonous chemicals and acids leaching into land and water supplies.) Do not pierce the battery with a nail or other sharp objects. To prevent overheating and rapid battery drainage, you are advised not to use it near an appliance which generates a strong electromagnetic field (E.g. microwave oven, hair dryer, electric shaver, etc.) Use only the specified power adapters when charging the Li-ion battery. Wrap waste/faulty battery terminals with insulation paper for storage and transportation. Do not place the battery/device inside the vehicle standing in direct sunlight for a longer duration. Stop using the battery if you observe too much heat, change in colour and odour, and battery bulge. Do not put heavy weight on the battery when storing it separately. (It may damage the battery and may result in fire and explosion.) Avoid overnight charging or leaving the device charging unattended for a longer duration. Store the battery/device at normal room temperature. Do not freeze the battery/device. Do not place the battery/device in direct sunlight. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

824.title: How can I connect my Smart TV to the Jio Home Gateway on my JioFiber network?
824.content: How can I connect my Smart TV to the Jio Home Gateway on my JioFiber network? | You can connect your Smart TV to your JioFiber network using either a LAN cable or Wi-Fi. Both options work well, and you can choose based on where your TV is placed and how strong your Wi-Fi signal is. Option 1: Connect using a LAN cable (recommended for best stability) Plug one end of the Ethernet (LAN) cable into the LAN port of your Jio Home Gateway (router). Plug the other end into your Smart TV’s LAN port. Your TV should automatically detect the wired connection and connect to the internet. A wired LAN connection gives you faster, more stable internet - ideal for streaming movies, OTT apps, and HD/4K content. Option 2: Connect using Wi-Fi On your Smart TV, go to Settings → Network/Wi-Fi Settings. Select your Wi-Fi Name (SSID) from the list of available networks. Enter your Wi-Fi password to connect. If your TV shows an option for Automatically Connect, enable it so your TV reconnects to JioFiber automatically every time. For the best Wi-Fi experience, ensure your TV is placed within good range of the router, avoid physical obstructions, and keep other large appliances away from the Wi-Fi path. Once connected, you’ll be able to stream OTT apps, watch live TV, play games, and enjoy smooth video playback through your JioFiber network. If your TV is not connecting or the internet seems slow, you can use the Run Diagnostics feature in the MyJio app to check signal strength and troubleshoot issues. Chat with us! 1017.title: How do I troubleshoot 'no dial tone or unable to make or receive calls' issues?
1017.content: How do I troubleshoot 'no dial tone or unable to make or receive calls' issues? | If you are facing an issue while using JioFiberVoice services, please follow the steps below to check and resolve it. Log in to the MyJio app and select 'JioFiber' Scroll down to the 'JioCare: Help & Support' section Click 'Run Diagnostics' Select 'Voice Services' Click on 'Run Diagnostics' If no issue is found after running diagnostics, simply follow the steps below as per the device on which you are facing the issue. For a Landline phone: Please make sure your landline instrument is connected to the Jio Home Gateway. Check if you can hear the dial tone. If not, reconnect the phone cable (RJ11/telephone wire cable) at both ends (landline and Jio Home Gateway). Ensure that the ‘Dial’ mode is set to ‘Tone’ mode and try rebooting the JioFiber Router once. For JioJoin on Android and iOS mobile devices: Make sure your mobile device is connected to JioFiber internet. If unable to complete first-time setup, visit ‘Mobile Settings’ and check if ‘Private DNS’ is enabled. Please disable it. If already configured, go to ‘Settings’ in the JioJoin app and check the status of the JioFiber Voice number. It should be ONLINE. If it is still not working, try uninstalling and reinstalling the app or rebooting the JioFiber Router once. For JioJoin on Jio Set Top Box: Make sure your Jio Set Top Box is connected to the Jio Home Gateway. If you are making a video call through your smartphone camera, ensure the JioJoin app is in the foreground, the mobile is connected to JioFiber Wi-Fi, and camera setup is complete. Ensure that the 'Mic & Camera' option is enabled in the JioJoin app mobile settings. If you are making a video call through JioTVCamera, try reconnecting the camera and rebooting the Jio Set Top Box and Jio Home Gateway (Router). To activate JioFiber Voice services, open the provided link and follow the steps. You can also watch a video to learn how to use a landline number to make and receive calls via JioFiber. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

1023.title: What is JioFiber?

1218.title: How can I hide my JioFiber Router Wi-Fi ID (SSID/Wi-Fi user name) so that it is not visible to others?
1218.content: How can I hide my JioFiber Router Wi-Fi ID (SSID/Wi-Fi user name) so that it is not visible to others? | You can hide your JioFiber Wi-Fi ID (SSID) through the MyJio app. When you switch off SSID visibility, your Wi-Fi name stops appearing in the list of available networks for any new device. This helps keep your home network private and secure. Just follow these steps to hide your JioFiber Wi-Fi ID: Open the MyJio app and select Fiber from the top menu. Tap the menu icon on the top left and select Settings. Go to Device Settings, then tap My Device. (Wait a few seconds for your router details to load.) Select Wi-Fi Settings. Choose the Wi-Fi name you want to hide. Turn off visibility using the toggle switch. After you turn off visibility, the selected Wi-Fi ID won’t appear for any new device searching for networks. Devices already connected will continue working as usual. You can also watch a video guide on how to manage your JioFiber Router for more help. Note: Hiding and unhiding Wi-Fi IDs is not available for JioAirFiber users right now. If you’re already logged into the MyJio app, you can manage your router directly from the 'Manage Device' section. Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

1340.title: How to play JioTambola?
1340.content: How to play JioTambola? | Tambola is a very simple game, in which numbers are called out on the top of the screen one at a time and the players need to strike the numbers on the ticket if it is a match. Listed below are the basic rules for playing the game: Numbers 1-90 are randomly called out on the screen and the players strike the number by tapping the number on their ticket. Tambola can be played throughout the day at 30-minute intervals. Each game starts afresh every half an hour, allowing participants the freedom to join as many games as they wish. Each player gets 1 free ticket daily which needs to be claimed by answering a question correctly. When the game begins, the numbers are drawn randomly and shown at the top of the screen. If you are late in joining a game, you can still participate and strike off numbers from the ticket. Click on the winning pattern shown below the ticket as soon as you achieve a winning combination. If your claim is invalid, it will be considered as Bogie and your ticket will be cancelled for the day. The time of making a claim is critical. If several people claim the same prize, then the first one to claim is eligible for the prize. You can play with only 1 FREE ticket per game. The game ends when all 90 numbers are called out or when all the prizes for that day are claimed (whichever comes first). Chat with us! Chat with us Link copied to clipboard

1530.title: MPLS v/s IP Routing: Which one should you pick?
1530.content: MPLS v/s IP Routing: Which one should you pick? | Seamless network connectivity facilitates data flow between various departments, applications, and external entities. Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) and IP Routing are vital solutions for ensuring this connectivity and improved productivity. | Both methods are essential in establishing a robust and efficient network infrastructure, but choosing between them depends on factors like data sensitivity, speed requirements, and budget considerations. Understanding the unique characteristics of MPLS and IP Routing will help you make an informed choice that suits your organization's specific needs. | Multiprotocol Label Switching Virtual Private Network (MPLS VPN) is a technology that creates a private network within a larger network. It efficiently routes data packets based on labels, allowing for faster and more secure communication between multiple locations or branches of an organization. MPLS VPN ensures data privacy and quality of service, making it a preferred choice for businesses requiring reliable and controlled network connectivity. | Moreover, JioBusiness stands apart by offering two variations ofJio MPLS VPN- Layer 2 (based on the concept of virtual LANs) and Layer 3 (based on the concept of routing). | IP Routing, or Internet Protocol Routing, is a fundamental method for forwarding data packets across networks. It involves using IP addresses to determine the best path for data transmission. IP routers make decisions based on routing tables, ensuring data reaches its intended destination. This cost-effective approach works well for non-critical data traffic but may lack the priority and optimization features of MPLS in more complex network setups. | The choice between MPLS and IP routing carries substantial implications for your organization's communication infrastructure. Let's delve into the pivotal distinctions that distinguish these two approaches: | When a packet arrives at a router, the router looks up the destination IP/MAC address in the LFIB to find the label and next hop. The router then encapsulates the packet with the label and forwards it. The RIB is used to learn about routes. When a router learns about a new route, it adds the route to the RIB. The LFIB then uses the RIB to forward packets. | IP routing involves maintaining routing tables containing details about IP addresses and associated routes to reach destinations. | In simpler words, MPLS is a more efficient and scalable way to forward packets than IP routing. It does this by using labels instead of IP addresses to forward packets. Labels are shorter and simpler than IP addresses, and hence, routers can process them more quickly. | With the right MPLS provider like JioBusiness, businesses can also leverage features like:
